# 00000007960

**English.** Definition: The isospectral classes of two-dimensional potentials under Moutard transforms: the graph G_M generated by Darboux-Moutard transforms on isospectral potential equivalence classes. Conjecture: G_M is an infinite bipartite graph whose vertex degree spectrum is {4,6} (the parity classes of Moutard four-points and octahedron six-points); and the count of equivalence classes of isospectral potentials (fixed spectral polynomial) is infinite, but the quotient under gauge equivalence is finite, the finite number equaling the number of connected components of the real form of the spectral curve; and the parity of the real component count agrees with the sign flip count of the potential (a Moutard extension of the Sturm-Liouville oscillation law). (Moutard isospectral bipartite graph)

**中文。** 定义：Moutard 变换的二维位势等谱类：Darboux–Moutard 变换生成等谱位势等价类的图 G_M。猜想：G_M 为无穷二部图，其顶点度谱为 {4,6}（Moutard 四点与八面体六点的奇偶类）；且同谱位势的等价类的计数（固定谱多项式）为无限，但在规范等价（度规变换）下商为有限，有限数等于谱曲线的实形的连通分支数；实分支数的奇偶与位势的符号翻转数一致（Sturm–Liouville 型振荡定律的 Moutard 推广）。
